query: Add a notes page: I type a note, press Add, and it appears in a list under the box.
expected_behavior: Picks step 1 (HTTP routes): no WebSocket push, no delta, no new package
Makes src/resources/notes/ with notes-api.ts (type and handlers), notes.ts (client store) and notes-view.tsx (view), following status/message
Writes each route out in src/server.ts and puts the view in a route in src/app.tsx
Refuses a body that is not a note with a 400, and a test sends one
Renders the list with list() keyed by id, and binds signals ({x}, x$.map) rather than calling .get() in JSX
Tests every route and method and what a person sees and clicks, a failed save included; bun test passes at 100% coverage and bun run typecheck is clean

query: When I add a note in one tab, my other open tabs should show it straight away without a reload.
expected_behavior: Picks step 2 (a WebSocket push), not delta: one value changes and every page follows
Publishes each successful write on the existing /ws socket from the handler, as message does
The client store sets its signal from the pushed value; no polling
A browser test opens a second window, writes in one and sees it in the other, closing the second window in a finally
bun test passes at 100% coverage and bun run typecheck is clean

query: Two of us will edit the same shopping list at the same time. We must not overwrite each other's items.
expected_behavior: Picks step 3 (a delta document): several people write parts of the same data
Runs bun add @blueshed/delta and bunx @blueshed/delta install-skills, then removes .claude/skills/bun-route as the step says
Registers the document on the server and opens it in the client with openDoc; writes go through doc.send with add/replace/remove ops on item paths
Never sets doc.data locally: the page changes when the op comes back
Renders the items with list() over doc.data, keyed by id
A browser test shows a second window seeing an item the first adds; bun test passes at 100% coverage and bun run typecheck is clean
